first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The long sniper rifle with a purple lightning pattern in the lower-right foreground, equipped with a long dark barrel and a large black scope.

entities.name: gun-holding hand
entities.identification: The partially visible hand and forearm below Weapon A, wearing a bright-green and gray-white paneled glove.

entities.name: group of white cargo crates covered with teal tarps
entities.identification: Multiple white compartmentalized crates in the area, with teal tarps covering their tops.

entities.name: stone-paved area
entities.identification: The light-brown-gray stone-paved ground around the cargo crates, including irregular joints, regular paving blocks, and red ground markings.

entities.name: group of fallen people
entities.identification: The group of dark-clothed people lying horizontally beside the steps and, later in the clip, in front of the vehicle, excluding Person B.

entities.name: outer road
entities.identification: The local section of road outside the low wall of the cargo-crate area where Vehicle A is located.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The faded light-green, low, box-shaped sedan behind and to the left of the central cargo crate later in the clip.

entities.name: low light-colored concrete wall
entities.identification: The low off-white wall with a wide, flat coping along the edge of the cargo-crate area.

entities.name: group of pale yellow-white flat-roofed buildings
entities.identification: The pale-yellow and off-white flat-roofed buildings in the background, with small windows, openwork parapets, and mottled walls.

entities.name: pale-blue sky
entities.identification: The continuous bright, pale-blue sky above the building roofs.

entities.name: group of overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin dark lines crossing the image above the roofs, some sagging slightly.

entities.name: group of curved-top streetlights
entities.identification: Slender dark streetlight poles along the street, with curled upper ends from which lamp heads hang.

entities.name: green vegetation in the neighborhood
entities.identification: Sparse green branches and leaves behind the wall and localized low grass at the foot of the wall.

entities.name: group of light-blue cylindrical bagged containers
entities.identification: The light-blue-gray upright bag-like container against the wall at the far left at the beginning, partially cropped by the image.

entities.name: group of gray upright poles
entities.identification: The slender gray upright poles near the background roofs, some with horizontal supports.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person whose dark head and shoulders are visible behind the low barrier to the left of the midground cargo crate at the beginning.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender dark firearm near Person B at the top edge of the barrier, separate from Weapon A in the foreground.
